title: Credit Card
body:
First of all, the bank’s customer service is the worst. Even though when you contact them, its said to wait 8 minutes, always I have waited for more than 30 minutes if I get connected. Usually it wont get connected to the person either. The charges on the card are unexplainable and service team also is ignorant of the charges. They just deduct so many charges without any explanation or calculations. I took the card because they offered easy payment plan with no interest. But in my case every month they used to deduct atleast a minimum of AED500 in average as finance charges. I took an amount of AED17,000 in August 2024 under EPP (0% interest) and I had to pay back around AED34,000 including all the deductions and charges and the principal amount within 10 months. I closed the card within 10 months due to these exorbitant charges even though the EPP was for 12 months. And when I inquired about the charges, nobody gave a response or answer.
Very bad experience. Never will I recommend to anyone. I am happy with my other bank card and its benefits. Even a few of their customer service representatives were very rude and impolite to me while I inquired about all this and they just cut the line and went off.
author: FlinnL

reply.body: Dear Flinn, we're sorry to hear that and sincerely apologise for the frustrating experience you've had with our customer service. Rest assured, we're right here to help. We request you to send us an email at atyourservice@bankfab.com and our team will get back to you at the earliest. Thank you so much for your patience.

I tried complaining about the matter 3 times via email i received a text message saying they tried to contact me but i was out of reach, first time i said maybe its true but after 2nd and 3rd time i was sure they do it in purpose because as i said on the opening of this review they treat low salary individual very poorly and my profile was worth their time to hear my complaint, i tried via call center they put me on hold for more than 46 min(i have a screen shot of the call as proof) when the agent finally answered i told them i was on hold for more then 46 min they said no way we answer right away i didnt bother to argue because i know they treat low salaried individuals poorly.
This all to say FAB should work more on providing a fair service to all.

title: The new update
body:
I’ve been trying to access my bank account for the past four days, and the experience has been extremely frustrating.

All I wanted to do was log in to my account, transfer money, and take care of some important matters. However, the new verification system in the banking app is completely impractical. The verification codes are not being sent to my phone number or my email, which makes it impossible for me to log in.

Because I kept trying to sign in and access my account, my account ended up being locked, which made the situation even worse.

To make things more difficult, I am currently outside the country, so I cannot visit a branch to resolve the issue. As a result, I’m unable to transfer money or do anything with my account.

I trusted this bank to be reliable and to support customers when they need access to their own money. Unfortunately, what’s happening now is causing serious inconvenience and stress. Instead of making things easier, the recent changes are making the service much harder to use.

Honestly, this whole situation is making me seriously consider changing banks as soon as possible if this issue isn’t resolved quickly.

I hope the bank reviews this issue and improves the system, because customers should not be locked out of their own accounts just for trying to log in.
author: n6_ow

reply.body: Dear Customer, thank you for your patience. Please go to the FAB Mobile login screen, tap the 'Forgot PIN' option and follow the steps to unlock your mobile banking access. We’re pleased to inform you that most of our mobile and internet banking services are now available following the region-wide IT disruption. Refer to our webpage www.bankfab.com for the updated list of available services and support initiatives that we’ve launched to make things easier.

title: The WORST BANK EVER
body:
Please don’t have anything to do with this bank. I was so stressed and no one helped me. I wanted to close my account online because I’m no longer in Dubai. I brought my account balance to zero so I could close it, as they requested, and I wasn’t expecting any future charges. But with this bank, it doesn’t matter if you follow all their instructions — they won’t let you close the account online unless you visit a branch.

Unfortunately, I can’t do that because I now work on a cruise ship for 9 months. The bank didn’t care about my situation. Even though my balance was zero, they charged me AED 25 as a monthly fee, which pushed me into a negative balance. Once you’re in the negative, they charge you AED 175 — all of this without informing you.

I brought my balance back to zero again and tried to contact them everywhere, but all I could get was a robot. My friend in Dubai even went to a branch to speak to someone on my behalf, but they literally kicked him out and refused to help.

In the end, just to avoid more charges while I’m away, I transferred AED 3,000. With other banks, you can at least talk to a real person and get support. But with FAB, it’s impossible. If anything happens in the future, you’re completely on your own. So disappointing. I cannot wait to be back in Dubai next year to finally close my account and get rid of this bank.

reply.body: Dear customer, we're so sorry for the frustration you have experienced while trying to close your account. title: Poor customer service
body:
I am extremely disappointed with the service I have received from this bank. A fraudulent transaction was posted to my credit card, and despite raising a dispute over two weeks ago, I have not received any acknowledgment or resolution.
Even after making multiple follow-up calls, the response has been completely lacking. Not only was the unauthorized charge ignored, but I was also left without any clarity or support from the bank’s side.
This kind of negligence is unacceptable, especially from a reputed financial institution where customer trust should be the top priority. Such experiences not only cause financial stress but also completely break confidence in the bank.
I had to eventually request cancellation of my card, as I no longer wish to continue my relationship with a bank that fails to protect its customers or even respond to genuine concerns.
Strongly disappointed and would not recommend.

title: Poor customer Service
body:
My experience with FAB has been extremely disappointing, especially when it comes to customer service. For a major bank in the UAE, I expected professionalism, efficiency, and clarity — but unfortunately, I encountered none of that.

Customer support is difficult to reach, and even when you manage to get through, the assistance is often unhelpful and lacking in proper follow-up. Simple issues take far too long to resolve, and there seems to be a lack of coordination between departments. Representatives often provide inconsistent information, which only frustrates customers further.

In addition, response times are slow whether you reach out by phone, email, or even visit a branch. Instead of offering solutions, the service can feel dismissive, leaving you to figure things out on your own. This is especially frustrating when dealing with important banking matters that should be handled quickly and professionally.

For a bank that promotes itself as one of the leading financial institutions in the region, this level of service is far below expectations. I hope FAB takes serious steps to improve its customer care, train its staff properly, and provide the level of service that customers in the UAE deserve.

title: Absolutely terrible banking experience with FAB.
body:
Absolutely terrible banking experience with FAB.

While I was traveling in the United Kingdom, FAB completely locked me out of both the mobile app and online banking. I urgently needed to transfer money, but I couldn’t access my account at all. The app simply would not work.

This is unacceptable for an international bank. Customers should be able to access their funds from anywhere in the world. Instead, I was left stranded without access to my own money during an important situation abroad.

The FAB app is constantly lagging, freezing, and malfunctioning. The functionality is limited, unreliable, and clearly not designed for customers who travel internationally. To make matters worse, customer support was either unavailable or completely useless when I needed help.

A bank should provide security and reliability. FAB provided neither. This has been one of the most frustrating banking experiences I have ever had, and I would not recommend this bank to anyone who travels or depends on online banking services.

Very disappointing.
★☆☆☆☆

title: The worst banking app and service ever
body:
I happened to be a FAB client because of my employer. I have been using the app since October 2022. So my top-5 concerns are:

1) Almost 50% of the time the app is under maintenance. Which is unacceptable. Whenever you want to make a maintenance do it during the night time, but not when people have to make the money transfers and etc.

2) When it is not under maintenance periodically when you need to do a money transfer even between your own accounts it just doesn’t work. 

3) The credit card interface is terribly flawed. When you make yourself a credit card payment it doesn’t show simultaneously that the card was paid. However the card limit available to spend increases by this amount. Frankly speaking, it is horribly misleading. 

4) FAB Etihad earned guest miles calculation - it is just a disaster. In the app right now it shows for me minus 639. When in fact I have been using the card since March, and have never redeemed the miles. What is the purpose of this widget if it doesn’t help at all???

5) The app is annoyingly slow.. It is not a mobile banking app at all if it is so slow in opening. 

I can keep on with the list forever, but now I would like to add some comments about the customer support which works very poorly:

1) I’m on a business trip in another country and I needed to reach the bank. I have been trying to reach the support via the number indicated at the website during the whole day. And nobody picked up the phone.

2) Whenever you write any inquiries (the urgent ones, as the phone line doesn’t work) to Atyourservice at bankfab dot com you are lucky if they reply you in a week.

To sum up, if I had a choice I would never use FAB. Disrespectful and flawed service. Change your attitude to the customer support and completely change your product and developers teams to the people who obtain a common sense and at least understand that doing maintenance during the business hours is a disaster. 

Best regards,

Nika

title: Extremely Disappointed with FAB Bank's Poor Service and Rude Customer Support
body: I have been a loyal customer of FAB Bank for the past five years, but my recent experience with them has been nothing short of a nightmare. Not only are they making it unnecessarily difficult for me to close my cards for personal reasons, but their customer service agent's rude and unsupportive behavior has left me extremely disappointed. Firstly, I reached out to FAB Bank to initiate the closure of my cards. Instead of providing me with a straightforward process to follow, they seemed to go out of their way to make it as complicated as possible. It feels like they are intentionally delaying the process, causing unnecessary frustration and inconvenience. As a long-term customer, I expected better treatment and a smoother experience when closing my accounts. To add insult to injury, the customer service agent who contacted me regarding my request was shockingly rude and unhelpful. Their lack of empathy and understanding was appalling. Instead of offering assistance or attempting to address my concerns, the agent displayed an unprofessional attitude and seemed more interested in rushing me off the call. It's truly disheartening to be treated with such disrespect after years of loyalty to this bank. As a customer, I value respectful and supportive communication. Unfortunately, FAB Bank failed to deliver on both fronts. The behavior of their customer service representative reflects poorly on the bank's overall commitment to customer satisfaction. If this is the level of service they provide to their long-standing customers, I can only imagine how they treat new customers or handle more complex issues. I urge potential customers to think twice before choosing FAB Bank as their banking partner. While my review may be based on a single incident, the lack of professionalism and courtesy displayed by their staff is indicative of a larger problem within the organization. Banking should be a positive experience, with reliable support and respectful treatment. Regrettably, FAB Bank falls short on these essential aspects, leaving customers feeling frustrated, undervalued, and disenchanted. In conclusion, I am deeply disappointed with FAB Bank's poor service and the rude behavior exhibited by their customer service agent. As a result, I have decided to sever ties with the bank and find a financial institution that values its customers and treats them with the respect they deserve

title: Formal Complaint Regarding Misleading Account Opening and Unjust Charges
body:
I am writing to formally escalate a complaint regarding a highly unprofessional and misleading experience with one of your sales representatives (B.F.), which has caused unnecessary inconvenience and financial concern.

I was contacted by your sales representative after requesting assistance in opening a bank account. During our discussion, I clearly explained my employment details and salary information. The representative was fully aware that my company is not listed under your approved companies for credit card eligibility. Despite this, he proceeded with opening a current account and submitted a credit card application without clearly informing me about the high probability of rejection.

After receiving my debit card, I did not receive any update regarding the credit card application. When I followed up with him via WhatsApp (as he personally requested), he informed me that there is a 90% chance that the credit card application would be rejected due to company eligibility. This information should have been transparently communicated before opening the account.

Based on this misleading process, I requested to close the account immediately since it was opened under incorrect expectations. However, I was informed that I would be charged AED 105 for account closure, which I strongly object to. This situation was not caused by my negligence but by the lack of proper disclosure and professional advice from your sales representative.

The representative mentioned he would raise a request to waive the charges but asked me to maintain AED 50 in the account, which I am currently doing in good faith while awaiting resolution.

I request the following actions:

• Immediate waiver of any account closure or related charges• Closure of the account without charges or Fees• Investigation into the conduct and communication transparency of the sales representative involved• Written confirmation once the matter is resolved

I have already registered this complaint under reference number: 2602******5286 and I expect this matter to be handled seriously and resolved promptly.

This experience has negatively impacted my trust in your institution, and I hope appropriate corrective actions will be taken.

Kindly treat this matter as urgent.

Sincerely,
A.M.
author: M111113

reply.body: Dear Customer, we apologise for the experience you have had with our customer support. Kindly share your details in a private message on Facebook @FAB or X (formerly Twitter) @FABConnects so that we can prioritise your concerns.

title: تقييم لتطبيق
body:
على حسب تجربتي مع بنك ابوظبي الاول والبنوك الاخرى تبين لي السلبيات التالية:-

- تاخير في عمليات التحويل من بنك الى بنك اخر عكس عمليات التحويل في البنوك الاخرى التي تتم في نفس اليوم.
- بعد ان يتم خصم القسط الشهري يتم الحجز على المبلغ او الراتب المتبقي لمدة يوم كامل.
- تأخير في جميع الطلبات لاسرجاع للمبالغ الزائدة في بطاقات الائتمان او طلب شهادات.

اما ايجابيات التطبيق هي:

- سهل وبسيط ومفهوم وواضح 
- آمن
- تتوفر فيه جميع انوع دفع الفواتير والمستحقات
- الاطلاع على القروض ومعرفة تاريخ الاستحقاق والمبلغ المستحق وغيرها
- يمكن للمتعامل تقديم طلبات عبر التطبيق دون زيارة الفرع.

ولهذا عن تجربتي الشخصية تقيمي للبنك والتطبيق مقبول كون هناك تطبيقات وبنوك اخرى افضل بكثير.

title: Half baked wallet with poor design and no real support
body:
The interface feels somewhat childish, overly gamified and visually busy for a financial app. With the amount of bright promotional content, rewards, vouchers, referrals, and repeated action tiles, it sometimes comes across as more playful than professional.

More importantly, basic banking information is missing. I could not find a clear answer anywhere in the app, help section, or FAQs about whether the account can receive an inbound international SWIFT transfer from an employer abroad. For a product that provides an IBAN and SWIFT code, that is a basic question that should be answered clearly.

Support is effectively nonexistent. My account holder name was clipped incorrectly, so I contacted support to have it corrected using the Emirates ID they had already verified. I have sent more than five emails and in-app support messages about the same issue and have not received a single meaningful response.

Payit is clearly not intended to be a full banking product, which is fine, but then it should be clear about what it can and cannot do. Instead, the app puts far more effort into promotions, rewards, remittances, and gamified features than into providing clear account information and functioning customer support.

It may be adequate for very basic wallet use, but I would not rely on it as a primary financial account.

title: Mobile banking disruption
body:
It has been over a week since I was able to access the mobile app or Internet banking services, which I rely on daily for managing my account, paying bills, and transferring funds. Despite the company's advanced technological infrastructure, its technical team has been ineffective in resolving the issue during this period, leaving many customers inconvenienced and unable to perform essential financial transactions remotely. This situation is highly problematic, as it forces numerous customers to visit a branch or an ATM to complete their transactions, which is impractical and time-consuming, especially for those with busy schedules or mobility challenges. The lack of a functional digital banking platform is extremely disappointing, as it significantly hampers our ability to manage finances conveniently and securely from any location.
In comparison, another bank experienced a similar issue but resolved it within 48 hours, restoring full access to their digital services promptly and minimising customer disruption.
author: ginoy jacob

title: Disappointing Experience with FAB and Its Mobile App – Poor Service and Unfair Policies
body:
I was initially excited to join a reputed bank like FAB, but unfortunately, my experience has been far from what I expected. The overall service quality — from customer service agents to complaint handling teams and even callback supervisors — has been disappointing and frustrating.

The mobile app, in particular, reflects the larger service issues within the bank. While it allows you to open a Fixed Deposit with ease, closing it is a completely different story. To close an FD, you’re required to visit a branch at least five days before its maturity date. Failing to do so results in a pre closure fee of AED 105 — a fee that, in many cases, outweighs the interest you might earn from the deposit.

This is just one example of how poorly designed and customer-unfriendly their processes are. In my experience, other banks in the UAE offer far better service standards, more transparent processes, and genuinely care about their customers.

Based on my experience, I would strongly advise reconsidering before opening an account with FAB.

title: 12,000 accounts suspended and counting..
body:
Avoid this bank at all costs. 

They announced the immediate suspension of over 12,000 accounts of business customers over an SMS stating that KYC documents were ‘out of date’. Accidentally they also suspended thousands of accounts, including ours, where documents were in fact all up to date. 4 days later and all accounts still suspended. 

So we can’t pay our salaries. Staff can’t pay rent and sending pics of landlords throwing their belongings out of their rooms. PDC cheques bouncing resulting in 95 (to date) forced account closures by the Central Bank since they suspended. Suppliers not delivering. Business can’t sell. More cheques bounce. Cargo stuck at ports. Customers flying in from all over the world to try and get their (fully up to date) accounts reopened. FAB staff calling in sick as they can’t handle the backlash. 

FAB: clearly should stand for Fail At Banking

title: Extremely Frustrating Customer Service Experience
body:
terrible customer service experience I recently had.

It took me multiple attempts — and a significant amount of my mobile balance — just to reach a live customer representative. When I finally managed to speak with someone, I was extremely disappointed to find out that he could not even assist me with my inquiry. Instead, he told me to call back again using my registered mobile number. Your contact number is not toll-free, and reaching you from a landline is even more difficult, making this request highly unreasonable.

I even asked him to simply transfer me to the correct person or department, but instead of helping, he just sent me back to the main menu — forcing me to start the whole exhausting process again. How frustrating and unprofessional.

Furthermore, the so-called “8-minute” estimated waiting time is completely inaccurate. The actual wait is much longer, causing even more unnecessary waste of time and mobile balance before even getting any real help.

Overall, this experience was extremely disappointing, and it shows a serious lack of respect for your customers’ time and money. I hope you take this feedback seriously and improve your service processes.

title: How this got a 4.8 rating I’d never know
body:
FAB mobile banking app takes you down memory lane. To the time when banks were experimenting with phone banking apps and no one had any clue what customer experience, or integrated/seamless technology was.

This app is comparable to my six year olds coding camp product. The authentication is so fool-proof that the only fool holding his/her breath is the customer. The authentication codes expire in two minutes but the security feature is so strong that it only sends you codes after 3 minutes. Potential misuse? Problem solved. 

You’ve also got to look at the interface with the type of nostalgia that should take you 15-20 years back. It does take a while to load - but in fairness they probably haven’t gotten to responsive designs in the coding camp for the kids that pulled this app together. 

If there was ever a competition of the best phone banking apps, this one certainly deserves a prize. But only for the misplaced bravado that they believe they can compete with other phone banking apps. 

I could also write about internet banking but it is so shoddy and unresponsive that I have no words for it. Literally.

I had a very frustrating experience with this bank. There is absolutely no communication with customers. I tried contacting them multiple times by phone and email, but no one responded at all.

It is very disappointing, especially when you need support or have urgent concerns. A bank should be reliable and accessible, but this one completely fails in that regard.

I would not recommend this bank to anyone based on my experience.
author: Sandoukhanbb
